rootCauses.title: BigQuery does not execute real queries
rootCauses.reproduction: Provider checks env flags and returns CONFIGURED in diagnose(), but fetchSeries() immediately returns a static INSUFFICIENT_DATA string mentioning 'bigquery-public-data.google_trends.top_terms' without invoking BigQuery client/API, dry-run, or query job.
rootCauses.impact: Queries claimed as evaluated against Google BigQuery were never executed upstream; bytes processed accounting and job IDs are non-existent.
rootCauses.correction: Implement genuine BigQuery client execution path with read-only access, parameterized term and region filters, schema validation, real dry-run, estimated bytes accounting, query budget enforcement, job ID tracking, timeout and cancellation handling, and truthful no-results classification.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: fetchSeries executes real dry-run and query when authorized; correctly records job ID, bytes processed, and table provenance; fails closed on unauthorized billable projects or budget breach.

rootCauses.title: BigQuery zero-cost verification is self-declared
rootCauses.reproduction: diagnose() trusts BIGQUERY_FREE_SANDBOX_VERIFIED=true and BIGQUERY_BILLING_ENABLED=false without independently querying Google Cloud project billing status.
rootCauses.impact: Self-declared environment variables can conceal billable projects or false-claim sandbox eligibility without independent verification.
rootCauses.correction: Implement independent Google Cloud Billing API check (GET https://cloudbilling.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/billingInfo). If billing state cannot be independently confirmed with read-only access, fail closed with BLOCKED_FREE_SANDBOX_NOT_VERIFIED.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: Provider returns BLOCKED_FREE_SANDBOX_NOT_VERIFIED when billing cannot be independently verified; blocks billable projects unconditionally.

rootCauses.title: G21 accepts a misleading backtest with hard-coded verdicts
rootCauses.reproduction: runBacktestV12_4_3_4_1() assigns 'passed = true' for candidate recovery, public dataset coverage, Google brand-only association, and Evergreen honesty without calling any business logic. G21 bundled async barrier, disk safety, SQLite check, and backtest into one passing verdict.
rootCauses.impact: 14/14 PASS reported on fake backtest; false PASS on G21.
rootCauses.correction: Separate Category A (policy/scenario unit tests) from Category B (genuine point-in-time historical product replay with DEV/HOLDOUT temporal splits). Remove all hard-coded 'passed = true'. Split G21 so barrier, disk safety, SQLite integrity, and backtest have independent assertions.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: All scenario checks execute actual business logic; historical backtest executes point-in-time product ranking against historical timestamps without synthetic pass branches.

rootCauses.title: Browser test silently skips when server offline and reports success
rootCauses.reproduction: When baseUrl (/api/v1/kh02/version) is unreachable, the test logs '[Notice] SWAI server at ... is offline; skipping standalone browser test' and returns early. Vitest treats early return with 0 assertions as PASS.
rootCauses.impact: Unexecuted browser tests conceal missing UI verification as green test passes.
rootCauses.correction: Browser test must enforce server readiness; if offline, report BLOCKED/fail test contract. Mandatory acceptance runner must never mark an unexecuted browser run as PASS.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: Standalone browser test fails or reports BLOCKED when server is offline; executes full Chromium navigation and element assertions when server is ready.

rootCauses.title: G15 lacks authoritative historical demand evidence
rootCauses.reproduction: Audited DB rows had evidenceReference: null; BigQuery queries executed was 0; verifiedImportsCount did not prove official Google provenance; 0 products qualified as Verified Evergreen.
rootCauses.impact: Evergreen qualification standard could not be satisfied legitimately.
rootCauses.correction: Require verifiable cryptographic and source provenance for demand series; distinguish local file integrity from authentic external Google provenance; reconcile 60-day vs 180-365 day requirement and report honest INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when external sources lack niche coverage.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: Synthetic fixture records cannot satisfy authoritative demand evaluation; lack of authoritative data yields honest INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

rootCauses.title: G16 Live Verified Top 3 shortfall (2/3) in Pet Gadgets
rootCauses.reproduction: Uproot Clean ad landed on CheckoutChamp funnel page (cc.uprootclean.com/main/phr) which lacked JSON-LD and OpenGraph product metadata, correctly leaving it PROBABLE. Shortlist liveVerified count was 2/3.
rootCauses.correction: Conduct forensic analysis on merchant landing page; execute bounded candidate recovery from current run's candidate pool for distinct VERIFIED products from different families with current-run live observations. If 3/3 cannot be legitimately achieved without weakening verification rules, truthfully report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with exact shortfall evidence.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: Candidates without verified merchant page metadata never receive VERIFIED status; candidate recovery only promotes genuine current-run live VERIFIED products from distinct families.

rootCauses.title: Google Ads MCP retrieval times out on Windows due to encoding and unbounded latency
rootCauses.reproduction: On Windows, python child process stdout defaults to cp1252. When advertiser name contains non-ASCII characters (e.g. 深圳有哈科技有限公司 for UAHPET), Python crashes with UnicodeEncodeError, breaking JSON-RPC pipe and causing 15s timeout on every domain.
rootCauses.impact: Stage 6 timed out on all attempted domains, returning 0 creatives and leaving the association ledger empty.
rootCauses.correction: Set PYTHONUTF8: '1' and PYTHONIOENCODING: 'utf-8' in StdioClientTransport spawn env; configure sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8') in googleTransparencyServer.py; bound creative count per domain to respect per-domain deadlines.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: Google MCP client connects, searches advertiser domain, and retrieves creatives without encoding crash or timeout.

rootCauses.title: CSV provenance and diagnostic capabilities overstated
rootCauses.reproduction: File checksum was used as proof of Google provenance; GoogleTrendsCsvImportProvider.diagnose() reported transportConnected: true and authenticated: true despite being a local filesystem/database adapter.
rootCauses.impact: Overstated diagnostic status and confusion between cryptographic file integrity and authoritative external source provenance.
rootCauses.correction: Separate distinct flags: fileExists, checksumVerified, sourceOriginVerified, productAttributionVerified, historicalCoverageVerified, eligibleForEvergreen. Fix GoogleTrendsCsvImportProvider.diagnose() to report transportConnected: false and authenticated: false (local storage adapter).
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: Checksum pass does not imply source authenticity; diagnostic status accurately reflects local adapter capabilities.

rootCauses.title: Acceptance artifacts oversized and contain malformed JSON control characters
rootCauses.reproduction: Acceptance generated redundant 90,000-line JSON artifacts with unescaped control characters in string fields, causing JSON.parse syntax errors.
rootCauses.impact: Disk bloat, parse failures, redundant artifact storage.
rootCauses.correction: Use compact indexed references, shared evidence keys, valid JSON string sanitization, and eliminate redundant huge payload duplicates while preserving complete forensic evidence.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: All acceptance artifacts parse cleanly as valid JSON; total artifact size is bounded and well within disk budget.

rootCauses.title: Nested test concurrency exceeds intended worker limit
rootCauses.reproduction: Outer runner limited top-level concurrency to 2, but child Vitest processes spawned internal worker threads equal to CPU core count (8-16), leading to up to 32 concurrent worker threads.
rootCauses.impact: CPU throttling, memory spikes, SQLite database lock contention, flaky timeouts.
rootCauses.correction: Pass explicit worker concurrency limits to child Vitest invocations (--maxWorkers=1 or --fileParallelism=false) so that total effective concurrency across all running tasks never exceeds configured limit.
rootCauses.regressionAssertion: Peak concurrent worker count is monitored and bounded; SQLite write operations remain contention-free.
